reason: Adding growing medium around the potato plants could cover developing tubers and keep them dark.
expectation: The medium will cover the new tubers while leaving the stems exposed.

effect: The growing medium does not combine with the potato bed, so I will try extending its existing lightproof covering instead.
reaction: I was surprised that adding medium was not an available option.
reason: The foil-backed cloth made the original potato skirt, so it is a plausible way to keep new tubers dark.
expectation: The cloth will extend the lightproof covering around the developing tubers.

alternatives.reason: The mesh could support the soybean stems and pods.

effect: The raised collar makes room for additional medium without burying the leaves, so I will try adding it now.
reaction: The need to extend the skirt first makes physical sense.
reason: The extended collar now has space for medium around the developing tubers.
expectation: The medium will fill the raised collar and help keep the tubers dark.

alternatives.reason: The mesh could support the filling soybean pods.

effect: The hilled bed completes the potato goal; the soybean row still needs support.
reaction: The collar and medium fit together satisfyingly.
reason: Cargo mesh can serve as a support for the soybean stems and filling pods.
expectation: The mesh will support the soybean plants and their pods.

effect: The mesh supported the soybean row and completed the remaining goal.
reaction: The support was a straightforward, sensible use of the mesh.

mostWorthwhile.text: Extending the potato collar and then adding medium was the most worthwhile sequence: it explained how to keep tubers dark without burying the leaves.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first attempt to add medium was unproductive; the feedback gave no indication that extending the collar first would make it possible.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the medium could not be added until the lightproof collar had been extended.

arbitrary.text: The initial rejection felt somewhat arbitrary until the extended collar revealed the intended sequence.

continue.text: I would continue: the short chapter made the crop-support decisions physically understandable, even though the initial feedback was limited.
